items.topic: Which wearable device(s) are you planning to use for passive data collection (sleep, HRV, activity)?
items.freeform: None yet. But should be written with dependency injection to ensure  that device support can be added easily. Also should be able to manually enter data

items.topic: Should the dashboard support mobile-first interactions (PWA/responsive) or is desktop-primary acceptable for P0?
items.freeform: Both (responsive) but mobile is most important

items.topic: What's the preferred event retention policy - keep all historical data indefinitely or implement retention windows?
items.freeform: Keep all data indefinitely (personal server, storage is cheap, historical trends are valuable). Also a way to manage data from the UI settings (like viewing the size and large files, cleaning all or selected data, etc. - the typical storage management type of things)

items.topic: Should the correlation engine require a minimum sample size before surfacing insights (to avoid spurious correlations)?

options.label: No minimum, show with confidence warnings

items.freeform: Yes - configurable threshold (from PRD OT-P1-1: "Configurable minimum data threshold before generating correlations")

items.topic: Which domain scenario should be built first alongside the dashboard to validate the integration contract?
items.freeform: Nootropics Tracker (from VISION.md: "lowest friction, immediate value, tight feedback loop", doesn't require hardware purchase)
